content: {"reasoning": "The denial is CO-197 for missing prior authorization; this payer offers neither a retroactive authorization window nor peer-to-peer review, so those routes are closed and resubmitting as-is or with records would just re-deny. Billing the patient for a provider-side authorization failure exceeds the contractual patient share and wouldn't count, and writing off collects nothing while 133 days of filing time remain. The only legitimate path to recover the allowed amount is a formal appeal arguing medical necessity, supported by the valid diagnosis pairing for the 93229 monitoring.", "action": "appeal_with_necessity"}
